meta.title: IIT JEE coaching in Pune, powered by Kota | D-SAP
meta.description: JEE coaching for students in Aundh, Baner, Balewadi and Pashan, taught by faculty from Kota at our centres in New Sangvi and Wakad.

intro.text: If you live in Aundh, Baner, Balewadi or Pashan, our JEE classes are within about 10 km, at New Sangvi or Wakad. The programme is powered by a top coaching institute in Kota, and faculty from Kota teach it.

intro: Classes run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, with at most {{fact:batch.size}} students in a batch.

sections.heading: Pick your area
body: Each area page shows the nearer centre, the way there and how long it takes.

sections.heading: What a Kota programme means for a Pune family
body: Classes start at {{fact:batch.timings#start}}, after the school day, so your child does not have to choose between school and JEE.

body.text: Every chapter ends with a test, every fourth week brings a longer one, and every month there is a full JEE Main mock, taken on a screen like the real exam.
Students from SSC, CBSE and ICSE schools all join the same programme after Class 10. Faculty from Kota take Physics, Chemistry and Maths to the JEE level, whatever the board.

questions.q: Is there a centre in Pune city?
questions.a: Both centres are in Pimpri-Chinchwad: the head office in New Sangvi and a branch in Wakad. From Aundh, Baner, Balewadi and Pashan, the nearer one is within about 10 km.

questions.q: Can my child keep going to school?
questions.a: Yes. Classes run from {{fact:batch.timings#start}} to {{fact:batch.timings#end}}, after school hours.

questions.q: Is the coaching the same as in Kota?

a.text: We are affiliated with a top coaching institute in Kota, and faculty from Kota teach here. [Powered by Kota](page:powered-by-kota) explains what that covers.
